homograph.note: The same spelling is also the past tense and past participle of "grind" (ground coffee, ground meat), which is etymologically unrelated to the noun "ground". A hint must say which word it targets.

senses.definition: used in the phrase "stand your ground", to keep to your position and refuse to be pushed back or frightened off

examples.en: She stood her ground and refused to lower the price.
examples.fa: او پای موضع خود ایستاد و حاضر نشد قیمت را پایین بیاورد.

translations: پای موضع خود ایستادن (در ترکیب stand one's ground)

senses.definition: the solid surface of the earth that people stand and walk on

examples.en: The apples had fallen and were lying on the wet ground.
examples.fa: سیب‌ها افتاده بودند و روی زمین خیس مانده بودند.

senses.definition: a reason for saying, doing or believing something, usually used in the plural as "grounds"

examples.en: He was dismissed on the grounds of repeated absence from work.
examples.fa: او به دلیل غیبت‌های مکرر از کار برکنار شد.
